about: src/lib/combo_menu_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (madar-catalog combo::choice_extra, what a pick adds from the public menu choice). features/public-ordering/pricing.test.ts runs the combo picker choiceExtra (the wasm) against it. A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it.
